items.label: servers, storage, network, cloud and GPU floors

blocks.text: Purview runs hybrid estates for enterprises and the GPU floors we build. One NOC, one toolset, one accountable owner, whether the workload sits in a hyperscaler, a sovereign cloud or a rack we installed. This is an operations contract for the estate you already have; designing and building a new network is the separate Network Solutions practice, which hands into this service once live.
